text_block_list.text:
To prepare for the Tenno Sho, Mejiro
McQueen's
training regimen has been
anchored around the
basics.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Onlookers and other trainers cast a
critical eye
over us. To them, the
regimen doesn't seem
practical for
garnering success.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In turn, things become a bit strained
between
Мэдзиро МакКуин and I.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This troubles her. However, she soon
realizes she
can trust me after speaking
with Мэдзиро Райан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We renew our faith in each other and
the promise
we share, returning to the
path we set for the
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
